description: Point-in-time event replay (scenario-event-replay; design docs/design/scenario_set_and_ablation_design.md §7.4, step 14b): could the scenario set as it stood the day before each episode have represented what happened? Each episode's as_of is the last trading day before it; horizon_days is the number of trading days of its realised window (yen carry 11 Jul - 5 Aug 2024, DeepSeek 27 Jan 2025, tariff 3-8 Apr 2025). Scenarios whose replay window ends on or after the as_of drop out. min_abs_z: smallest realised |z| that counts towards direction accuracy. sleeves: book factor -> sleeve for the per-sleeve direction accuracy.
